abstract: We report a rare case of a benign adult sacrococcygeal teratoma discovered during pregnancy. The cystic mass was confirmed on CT scan and magnetic resonance imaging. In the fifth postpartum month, three cysts (1, 2.5, and 6 cm) were excised. Pathologically, the specimens contained differentiated tissue from all three germ layers, including endocrine tissue within the ectopic exocrine pancreas.
abstract_ja: 妊娠中に発見された成人の良性仙尾部奇形腫の稀な症例を報告する。嚢胞性腫瘤はCTおよびMRIで確認された。産後5か月目に、3つの嚢胞（1cm、2.5cm、6cm）を切除した。病理学的に、3胚葉すべての分化組織が認められ、異所性の外分泌膵組織内に内分泌組織が含まれていた。
